Mantova had played consecutively in [[Serie A]] from the 1961–62 season to 1964–65, and from the 1966–67 season to 1967–68 as '''Associazione Calcio Mantova''', when the team was called "Little Brazil", as its playing style recalled Brazilian football. Since 2010, the club went bankrupt twice and continuously played between [[Serie D]], [[Lega Pro Seconda Divisione]], and the new [[Serie C]] under the name '''Mantova F.C.''' and, since 2017, Mantova 1911. After another relegation to Serie D in 2023, the club was readmitted to the third division, winning it immediately and returning to [[Serie B]] in 2024 after 14 years."}}
